```csharp
(OutSystems.Model.IESpace eSpace) => {
    
    /*** creating IClientAction 'ValidateEmail' ***/
    var validateEmail = eSpace.CreateClientAction("ValidateEmail");
    validateEmail.Description = "ValidateEmail (synthetic)";
    validateEmail.Public = false; // default value
    
    var startNode = validateEmail.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();
    validateEmail.Function = true;
    var email = validateEmail.CreateInputParameter("Email");
    email.DataType = eSpace.EmailType;
    var ifNode = validateEmail.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IIfNode>().ConnectedBelow(startNode, 2057);
    ifNode.SetCondition("Index(Email, \"@\") > 0");
    var endNode = validateEmail.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    var formatDate = validateEmail.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IExecuteClientActionNode>("FormatDate");
    var formatDate2 = eSpace.ClientActions.Named("FormatDate");
    formatDate.Action = formatDate2;
    var endNode2 = validateEmail.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    ifNode.TrueTarget = endNode;
    ifNode.FalseTarget = formatDate;
    formatDate.Target = endNode2;
}
```
